template.name: Hospital Patient Satisfaction Survey
template.description: Patient experience feedback to improve hospital outpatient and inpatient care quality.

questions.text: How satisfied are you with the waiting time before your consultation?
Did the doctor explain your medical condition and treatment clearly?
How would you rate the cleanliness of the hospital and patient rooms?
Did the nursing staff treat you with courtesy, compassion, and respect?
Which hospital department or facility did you visit today?
Please provide any additional comments or suggestions for improving our care.
questions.placeholder: Your valuable feedback helps us serve you better...
